# Wharf 0.14.0 changes

- Added read-only `RunStatusService` snapshots with lifecycle counts,
  occupancy, retries, and ETA.
- Added `GracefulStopService` with bounded cancellation and targeted
  ephemeral-resource cleanup.
- Added durable completion and blocked notification sinks.
- Added an optional HTTPS webhook notification sink.
- Added status, stop, cleanup, and notification tests.
